request: Двусторонний reuse-аудит QAZ.INDUSTRIES без публикации общих примитивов

target.dirty_state: clean at audit start; target-only candidate changes follow

target_outcome.mandate: Сохранить подтверждённый contract-only reuse и добавить безопасный локальный machine discovery без межпродуктового переноса данных.
user_jobs: Понять provenance тематических материалов без копирования snapshots
preserved_contracts: Browser does not call QazLake/QazGeo upstreams
QazGeo remains a local sanitized static snapshot
QazStack central registration remains separate from product reuse

coverage.notes: Один allowlist задаёт все machine entrypoints.
RU названия и RU/KK/EN product locales не импортируют чужой контент.

evidence: Decision records product-state semantics in audit
coverage.notes: Новый публичный machine index не создаёт AVDS UI.
Только build-time static files; backend не добавляется.
QazStack reuse retained; central registry evidence remains separate.
No credentials, private data, browser upstream calls, or foreign snapshots.
Generated outputs are build, immutable-artifact and release checked.

candidates.name: QazStack thematic-product-contracts
candidates.rationale: Уже объявлен в central consumer и manifest; новая продуктовая миграция не нужна.
candidates.rollback: Удалить только при согласованном изменении product contract.
candidates.update_path: QAZ owner updates local contracts; QazStack owner governs primitive.

candidates.name: Reviewed source registry pattern
candidates.rationale: Локальный public registry уже закрепляет права и границы источников.
acceptance: scripts/check_public_contracts.py validates registry rights and URLs
candidates.rollback: Удалить ссылочный record при отзыве rights approval.
candidates.update_path: QAZ owner maintains reviewed records; upstream owner owns source release.

candidates.name: Target-native machine discovery pattern
candidates.user_value: Машины получают безопасную карту публичных QAZ interfaces.
candidates.rationale: Воспроизводится только паттерн QZ.Energy; код, отраслевые данные и snapshots не переносятся.
donor_refs: https://qz.energy/ai-index.json (public behavior reference only; no donor source artifact is consumed)
candidates.rollback: Remove the two generated files and their allowlist entry together.
candidates.update_path: QAZ owner changes the local allowlist and regenerates output.

candidates.name: QZ.Energy and Qazaqstan.Space federation
candidates.user_value: Отраслевой контекст остаётся проверяемым без скрытого data coupling.
candidates.rationale: Только thematic release/source contract links; snapshots не копируются.
dependencies: Upstream releases remain owned by their products
candidates.rollback: Withdraw an individual link record if contract or rights evidence is withdrawn.
candidates.update_path: Upstream owner releases source contract; QAZ owner reviews link metadata.

candidates.name: Qazaq Family Atlas import
candidates.user_value: Не создаёт оправданной ценности для индустриального контракта.
candidates.rationale: QAZ needs own sanitized QazGeo snapshots with exact revision and fail-closed verification.
candidates.update_path: QazGeo owner governs any future public projection.

candidates.name: QazStack temporal diff
candidates.user_value: В будущем может дать build-time change pulse.
candidates.rationale: Сейчас отсутствуют две сопоставимые исторические snapshots и назначенный release owner.
candidates.update_path: QazStack owner proposes versioned contract after evidence exists.

candidates.name: Shared reviewed-static-snapshot discovery
candidates.user_value: Нейтральная build-time schema/freshness/digest/fail-closed проверка могла бы убрать дублирование.
candidates.rationale: Потребители QAZ.INDUSTRIES, QZ.Energy и Qazaqstan.Space предполагаются, но единый contract и QazStack owner approval не подтверждены.
candidates.rollback: No extraction or publication was performed.
candidates.update_path: QazStack owner only after identical contracts are reviewed.

candidates.name: Sanitization of twenty regional geometries
candidates.user_value: Может быть полезно только как QazGeo-owned public projection.
candidates.rationale: Не является QazStack primitive; extraction возможен у QazGeo owner после двух подтверждённых consumers.
candidates.update_path: QazGeo owner owns any future extraction.

candidates.name: Loading, offline and degraded UI states
candidates.user_value: No shared primitive preserves product-specific failure semantics.
candidates.rationale: State semantics are product contracts; visible implementation is governed by AVDS.
candidates.update_path: Each product owns its state semantics; AVDS owns only visual primitives.

target_changes: Target-native ai-index.json and llms.txt generated from public allowlist
Build, static-site, public-contract and release-artifact checks extended
Decision and ledger document explicit non-extractions

evidence: Local source candidate only; no deploy was part of this audit
release.notes: Provider CI, central registry and public runtime must be proved separately after an authorized release.
